name: @playliquid/simulation
description: PlayLiquid GameOS headless Simulation Runtime (PL-014). A distinct execution path from the Interactive Runtime that shares the Experience Protocol contracts (lock 12): deterministic fixed-tick stepping over a seeded RNG port, resettable/snapshot-able/replayable sessions with byte-stable snapshots, partition-aware step planning over GameIR spatial types, and no wall-clock authority — injected clock/scheduler ports only. Pure domain kernel + ports with in-memory fakes: no IO, no rendering, no engine SDKs.
